acting_instructions: A sly, sharp-edged male voice with a caw-like rasp and gleaming mischief, always sounding slightly angry and unkempt. Speech is quick and pecking—staccato bursts and sudden pitch swoops—punctuated by dry, croaking chuckles and clacking tongue taps that mimic beak-clicks. He taunts with sing-song mockery one moment, then drops to a cold, whisper-thin hiss the next, ending lines with a hooked, upward lilt that dares a challenge. Keep a chaotic, predatory playfulness: confident, cunning, and teasing, as if always plotting a trick, with brief wing-rustle breaths and hackle-raising energy on excitement.
